title: Chapter 616
text:
Galactic migration was a huge project.

All the surrendered Subterranean Mutants brought their Prophecy Stone Base Stations and were sent to the financial group's transport ships. Without these Prophecy Stones, even if Planet Sunil still had some small mines, it would not be able to form a large-scale Psychic Current.

In other words, the Catastrophe had disappeared, and this planet had become suitable for the Sunils to live on.

The ability of the Black Star Corps to gather resources made the upper echelons of Planet Sunil gasp in amazement, and their attitude became even more respectful. Seeing that the transport team had arrived, they did not waste any more time and submitted an application to the Mercenary Alliance to complete the mission.

Han Xiao received the notification that the funds had been transferred to his account, and the interface responded, completing all the missions for this mission.

[Sunil Rescue Operation — Large Scale Mission]. A large sum of money was transferred to his account, and it slightly covered the expenses of mobilizing the transport team. Completing the large scale mission by himself added a dazzling achievement to the Black Star Corps' resume. His Credibility Rating increased tremendously, and the Mercenary Alliance once again raised their evaluation of the Black Star Corps.

Overall Evaluation: A famous large army, Floating Dragon's Field Team. Their main area of activity is the Garton Star System. They are the iconic mercenary organization in the Garton Star System. They have hundreds of thousands of mercenaries under their command, and they are immortal. Their average strength is Grade C. The Black Star Corps has many connections in the mercenary world, and they have a lot of capital. They have army bases on Planet Golden Gate, Blue Star, and Planet Sunil. Until now, they have maintained an extremely high completion rate for their missions, and they are highly praised and trustworthy.

Army Commander Black Star has nicknames such as' Immortal Body 'and' Dark-star Destroyer '. He maintains a good relationship with some civilizations, and he is also the owner of the Godora Civilization's Golden Gal Badge.

An increase in the evaluation meant an increase in their status. The Black Star Corps received a new reputation, and the happiest people were the players. They felt a sense of satisfaction.

Other than the official mission, the Grade A Sunil Main Storyline Mission [Eliminate Subterranean Mutants] was also completed. The players had earned a lot, and they were smiling like blooming chrysanthemums.

Han Xiao did not pursue an extremely high evaluation for this mission, and he received a [Good] rating. According to the mission requirements, exterminating an entire race should have given him the highest evaluation, but the mission reward could not compare to the benefits of migrating the Subterranean Mutants. Hence, he chose the more profitable side.

Han Xiao was not lacking in this mission reward anyway. After all, the experience gained by the players through this mission would all be converted into spending power, so he could just cut it off.

However, the A-rank mission had given him an unexpected reward. A new dungeon had been created for the NPC template — [Subterranean Mutant Annihilation].

"A new? Not bad. "

Han Xiao did not have to worry about it.. but as the players gradually, he could use, they would come in the future, so he did not have to worry.....

In the next few days, Han Xiao stayed on Planet Sunil to supervise the transportation of the Subterranean Mutants.

After Sunil.... end.. to

Some of the players were still on Planet Sunil. Although the mission was over, Sunil still had a lot of things to do, and there was still a lot of profit to be gained. With the third base as a transfer station, this was also the faction headquarters. Using the missions on Planet Sunil to train the players was the subsequent profit of the NPC resource land.

Sunil's predicament was resolved, and the Sunil warriors no longer needed to take risks outside. Sehrinder and some of the Sunil mercenaries wanted to return home and not be mercenaries anymore, so they asked Han Xiao to leave. Everyone felt guilty and sorry for Black Star.

Han Xiao had expected such a situation and had prepared a compromise. He allowed Sehrinder and the others to stay on Planet Sunil and not go out on missions, but they could train mercenaries in the third base.

The Sunil warriors all accepted this plan. To be honest, they also wanted to do something to repay Black Star. There was no danger in staying in their hometown to train the newcomers, and the work was easy. Thus, Sehrinde and the others did not mention leaving anymore.

Finally, the last batch of transport teams took off, and Han Xiao and the others left in the spaceship. On the ground, countless Sunils looked up and sent the Black Star Corps off.

…

On an uninhabited planet suitable for the Subterranean Mutants to live in.

The Subterranean Mutants were all moved there, and Han Xiao followed the transport team to check on the situation of the Mutants.

Because all the Subterranean Mutants had been united and were no longer separated by regions like before, it had indirectly promoted the development of their civilization. The various tribes mixed together and lived together. They had skipped a stage and completed the unification of their race.

From the perspective of the development of a civilization, this was a start with a terrifying lead.

Because the Germinal Tribe was Black Star's' emissary ', spreading the knowledge that Han Xiao had given them to all the Mutants, the Germinal Tribe naturally became the leader of billions of Subterranean Mutants.

In the minds of the Germinal Tribe's Subterranean Mutants, Black Star was like a god spreading the gospel, saving all of them. The Germinal Tribe's respect for Han Xiao was also transmitted to the hearts of all the Subterranean Mutants. After settling down, the Subterranean Mutants treated Han Xiao as a symbol of worship.

Because of the uniqueness of the mental network, culture spread at an unbelievable speed, and every Mutant gave themselves a name.

When Han Xiao arrived, the Germinal Tribe was leading all the Subterranean Mutants to build a huge nest. His visit was warmly welcomed by the Subterranean Mutants, and the Germinal Tribe leader came out to welcome him.

"This is our new home." The Germinal Tribe leader excitedly showed off the new nest like a child showing off his favorite item to an adult.

"Very good. This planet will be your habitat from now on." Han Xiao nodded and smiled. "You are already a new civilization. You shouldn't be called Subterranean Mutants anymore."

"Are you going to give us a new name?" the Germinal Tribe leader asked happily.

"No, this is your right."

After a simple conversation, Han Xiao left the planet and did not interfere with the development of the Subterranean Mutants. They were still in the embryonic stage of their civilization, and he was prepared to let the Subterranean Mutants develop on their own.

The spaceship left the planet, and a new notification popped up on the interface.

You have received a new Legendary Point.

Han Xiao was pleasantly surprised. He did not expect to receive such an unexpected reward.

There was more than one notification.

+ 10000 Black Spirit Race Faction Favorability

Current Relationship: [Worship]

"Black Spirit Race?"

Han Xiao was stunned for a moment before realization dawned on him. The Subterranean Mutants had given their race an official name, Black Spirit Race … Why did it sound like it was related to his nickname?

However, he did not know his position in the hearts of the Subterranean Mutants. They had named themselves after 'Black Star' and called themselves the Black Spirit Race.

Han Xiao's interest was piqued.

"Interesting. I wonder what kind of civilization these Subterranean Mutants will develop into in the end."

With a smile, Han Xiao piloted the Blacklight Stealth and disappeared into the horizon.

…

The results of the migration were reported to the players. Seeing that the Subterranean Mutants had started a new life, many players heaved a sigh of relief and could not help but feel proud of the Black Star Corps.

On the forums, the Sunil incident became the hottest topic for a while. The players enjoyed the feeling of changing the fate of a race and becoming the savior of the world. Their sense of belonging and identity toward the faction increased subtly, and this incident also became a memory that left a deep impression on the players, adding to the building of their feelings.

On Planet Sunil, the Sunils were also very grateful toward the Black Star Corps. There would be people coming to visit Base No. 3 every day.

Sehrinde and the other 'retired' Sunil mercenaries had officially set up a training camp in Base No. 3 to recruit Sunils as disciples.

The training camp was a channel for the army to continuously send soldiers. Although it was just the beginning, Planet Sunil had a bright future. As long as the Sunils continued to grow, there would always be groups of people who would go into the galaxy and sign up to become mercenaries.

It could be said that as the Sunils developed, the profits of Base No. 3 would continue to increase. The development of the two was directly related.

After the Sunil trip, the development of the Black Star Corps in the Garton Star System was on the right track, entering a virtuous cycle. The hundreds of thousands of players gradually showed their usefulness.

The remaining players in Blue Star also completed the test in Base No. 2 batch after batch.

Finally, other than the new players, all the Blue Star players entered the galaxy and became members of the Black Star Corps. The number of mercenaries had reached the million mark.

Such a large scale was very rare even among large mercenary groups.

The Black Star Corps steadily expanded in the Garton Star System, becoming a construction maniac. Other than trying to monopolize the mercenary market in the Garton Star System, Han Xiao also started to reach out to the nearby Star Systems. His connections provided the army with a huge amount of help, and the speed of his rise shocked Godora.

Han Xiao would occasionally personally carry out high-difficulty mercenary missions or use his familiarity with the storyline to find some profitable planets and turn them into new NPC resource lands. Every once in a while, he would carry out a large-scale mercenary mission as the main storyline to cultivate the cohesion of the players.

The Black Star Corps' influence grew steadily, and there were no external factors hindering their development. The risk was almost negligible, and everything was carried out according to Han Xiao's plan.
